tldr: Mars through the 1st house brings focus to self, body, identity, and first moves.
body: Mars transiting the 1st house energizes self, body, identity, and first moves. For about six weeks, drive, heat, conflict, desire, and action move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is an activation transit: it brings momentum and courage, but also heat that needs a clear outlet.
business: Mars supports personal presence: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Impulsiveness, conflict, burnout, or over-identifying with the moment.
advice: Aim the fire in the 1st house deliberately. Work with self, body, identity, and first moves without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
